notes.title: We're Runner-Ups in Hardcore Gamer's 2020 Awards!
notes.content:
[i]Can we get a watt watt! [/i]

[h3]Filament is a Runner-Up in the Puzzle Category at this year's Hardcore Gamer Awards 2020!
[/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631314/76e1f883b02ed316623e805b5b66510444bc3c06.jpg[/img]


This has been one astronomical year for Filament. First our game released on PC, Mac and Linux in April, then we brought it to Nintendo Switch in October and now it's part of the Hardcore Gamer Awards selection!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631314/5e1fa8fec06869ee4f67b4caddaa599b17998711.png[/img]


So before we head back into orbit for the holidays, we'd like to thank each and every one of you who have helped make Filament what it is today.

Come celebrate with us on Discord and Twitter (links in the comments) as we share the de-lightful news with hundreds of Operatives!

notes.title: VOTE FOR FILAMENT IN THE STEAM AWARDS!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631314/f63e5be2877c8196f61562559a603831d69ce11a.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Fire up your Alabaster engines, Operatives! [/h3][/b]

We have a proposition for you. This year, we are proud to announce we are putting ourselves forward for [b]The Best Game You Suck At Game Award![/b]

[b]
[h3]If we win, we will design Pluto and a robot in black tie to say thank you! [/h3][/b]

After all, though we released Filament in April, we have already had:

- Thousands of Operatives playing our title
- A Nintendo Switch release
- Astronomical updates including a hint system, new languages & narration logs
- Released our soundtrack on Steam & so much more!

As such, we do hope you'll vote for us till December 1st so that we can take to the stars in the awards. 

If you need more convincing, we'll let our immersive art, 2D animations, music, narrative, gameplay and everything else do the talking. 

Do let us know in the comments if you voted for us, or share your vote on:

Discord (https://discord.gg/FilamentPuzzle)
Twitter (https://www.twitter.com/FilamentPuzzle) 
Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/KasedoGames)
Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/KasedoGames)

Till next time, [i] enjoy Filament![/i]

The Beard Envy crew.

notes.title: Filament Bug Fixes & Updates - 24th April 2020
notes.content:
First of all:

Thank you to those who told us about these game bugs & reported them to us on both here on Steam community & on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/filamentpuzzle]Discord. [/url]

You make our cosmic game that much better by doing so, so thank you!  

So here's our Filament Hotfix for 24/04/2020:

- Fixed the rare bug that yeets player into space.
- Fixed the cable that wasn't lighting up in requisite 8.
- Fixed the options menu not correctly detecting resolution.
- Fixed the terminal not unlocking when tabbing out as terminal launches.
- Fixed the terminal transparency sorting issue.
- Fixed the log numbers displaying wrong in different languages.
- Fixed the issue with Opus 3 anchor not begin accessible after using ladder.
- Fixed the issue getting stuck behind anchor in medbay.
- Fixed the collision on requisite 5.
- Archways now make a noise when you pass through them.
- Fixed the visual issues in living room.
- Fixed the visual issues in kitchen.
- Fixed the archways not closing an already open door when you overload them.
- Fixed the wrapping pillars not closing an already open door when you overload them.
- Fixed formatting issues in messages when viewing in Japanese.

Speak to you soon, Operatives!

notes.title: An interstellar invitation to say thank you.
notes.content:
[h3]Watt a time it's been! [/h3]

[h2]We can't believe our game is out in orbit, as both the base game & the Marmalade Edition![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631314/24e26fc957181169e62409d0291496452d4f033f.jpg[/img]

[h3]We've already had: [/h3]

[h2]- Close to 20 Positive Steam reviews
- 125+ members join our Discord since launch
- 300 followers on Twitter & so much more![/h2]

[h3]We've had requests for bandages to help with headaches, many laughs from you all over how much we love beans (seriously, it's true), star-filled game screenshots & so much more.

But despite all this, there's one thing we value most of all.[/h3]

[h2]You. [/h2]

[h3]You're unyielding dedication & passion for Filament has taken us from a light-bulb moment 3 years ago to releasing the indie game gem it is today.[/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631314/ed37eb5e7af7ca14b290a028335d5e1d5447ed62.jpg[/img]

[h3]As such:[/h3]

[h2]Please accept this exclusive invitation to our Discord server as a thank you. [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631314/9ee772e64faec23e55f02f98e684347157eeb849.jpg[/img]
[h3]

Here you will be allocated a colour-based code name, can try your hand at our meteoric puzzle-filled server mini-game, complete our virtual training exercises & so much more. [/h3]

[h3]Not only that, but you can also put forward feature requests, report any minor bugs & ask for help during the game too. [/h3]

[h3]So come[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/filamentpuzzle] join us[/url] & be an official member of the Filament Corporation![/h3]
[h2]
Till next time, Operatives! [/h2]

[h3]*Salutes.*[/h3]

notes.title: T-5 days until our game launch!
notes.content:
Greetings, Operatives! 

My, how time flies up in space. 

[h3]First of all, thank you for wish listing & supporting our starry title![/h3]

Without you, we would not be where we are.

Secondly: 

[h3]I am delighted to announce that there are now just 5 days until game launch day![/h3]

To celebrate, we are holding a week of Filament-themed training camp on the Discord server [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/filamentpuzzle]here![/url]

With a complex virtual puzzle mini-game, quizzes galore, colour-based code names & more, there will never be a dull day on the server this week!

To celebrate the launch too: 
[h3]
We have a musical preview of the soundtrack from composer Tom Rumbellow! [/h3]

Please take a listen to the fantastic Floor 2 sneak peak [url=https://soundcloud.com/kasedo_games/filament-soundtrack-preview-floor-2]here. [/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631314/072841a65142ab801e5030e9f03c7da8cfe66ac2.png[/img]

We also have a "guess which puzzle are you" quiz on our [url=https://twitter.com/FilamentPuzzle/status/1250846562319769607]Twitter page.[/url] 

I wonder which one you are? Let us know in the comments!

Finally:
[h3]
We have a de-lightful video featuring many of our streamers & demo players, asking "hello?" to show solidarity with those Operatives who have been at home recently. [/h3]

Do come watch it [url=https://twitter.com/FilamentPuzzle/status/1248309731099279360]here.[/url] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631314/f0241c48df6937e22e6df265f8717eda84c1eb62.jpg[/img]

So from myself & the Filament Corporation, thank you once again & I do hope you'll come join us, on Twitter & Facebook, where our training camp continues.  

I'll be back on Thursday! 

Until then, 

Over & Out!

Officer Porcelain.

notes.title: We're this week's feature in PCGamesN's Unreal series!
notes.content:
[h3]Have you heard this recent Unreal announcement?[/h3]

[h2]We're the latest feature in PCGamesN's Unreal series! [/h2]

[h3]Come find out how we used Unreal Engine & our Epic Games Megajam win to create " a curious conundrum of a game...that is tantamount to genius."[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631314/b7d3e3bbe4cf47c47aaffddcf324857572026d0b.jpg[/img]

[h3]In this piece, you can also learn more about our inspiration for the game, including the Japanese Metabolism architecture movement; a modular take on architecture, not unlike the structures that make up today's space stations & rockets! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631314/f18272a9f2266b9a0209415d28b88d16c61a24e0.jpg[/img]

[h3]Discover all of this and more in the feature [url=https://www.pcgamesn.com/filament/making-it-in-unreal]here. [/url][/h3]

[h3]Don't forget to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/FilamentGame]Twitter[/url] to stay up-to-date with the Filament's progress, to get puzzle sneak peaks and to learn more about our concepts, ideas and hopes for the game.  [/h3]
